metadata.article_title: Jurisdiction and powers of the Federal Court under existing law to be exercisable by the Supreme Court

article.title: Jurisdiction and powers of the Federal Court under existing law to be exercisable by the Supreme Court
article.content:
135Jurisdiction and powers of the Federal Court under
                existing law to be exercisable by the Supreme Court



Article 135 · Part V


Until Parliament by law otherwise provides, the Supreme Court shall also have jurisdiction and powers
                with respect to any matter to which the provisions of article 133 or article 134 do not apply if
                jurisdiction and powers in relation to that matter were exercisable by the Federal Court immediately
                before the commencement of this Constitution under any existing law.
